timeline.sampleTimes: frameIndex/30 for frameIndex 0..1799; t=60 is connector state, not a duplicate output frame
timeline.interpolation: For each phase u=(t-start)/(end-start), speed=v0+(v1-v0)*(3u^2-2u^3). Integrated station increment=duration*(v0*u+(v1-v0)*(u^3-0.5*u^4)). Speeds parameterize station; true 3D speed=stationSpeed*sqrt(1+0.03^2).

road.intersectionRule: Through boulevard remains continuous and green; no abrupt grade or width change; cross streets follow local grade.

camera.exposure: Locked per shot; record actual engine settings in render manifest.
camera.crop: Preserve full source aspect. Portrait uses contain/letterbox; no stretch or implicit FOV change.
camera.poseExport: Render owner must export actual position/quaternion/projection or camera-to-world matrix per frame. Contract is intent; rendered metadata is authority.

composition.nearFacadeRule: Keep first120m low-rise 6–15m except isolated set-back towers; avoid symmetrical high canyon.
composition.coastRule: Gap in right frontage reveals bay and far shore lights. Water does not erase the broad city.
composition.sky: Deep desaturated blue with subtle cloud value variation; no decorative star flecks.

layers.geometry: Real road, curb, lamp posts, alpha-mask palms, facades with setbacks and balconies.
layers.lighting: Local warm fixture pools and restrained road sheen.

layers.geometry: Varied 8–32m buildings with interrupted rooflines, setback entrances, sparse signs; instance modules.
layers.lighting: Window atlases with spatially coherent occupied floors, differing brightness, mostly dark interiors.

layers.geometry: 300–600 inexpensive silhouettes across 3km width; clusters interleaved with low gaps; 3 distinctive landmark crowns.
layers.lighting: Emissive window atlases or cards; no point light per window.

layers.geometry: Low-detail horizon terraces/light fields fixed in world coordinates.
layers.lighting: Reduced contrast and saturation through layered haze; preserve visible broad light density.

lighting.bloom: Restrained highlight halo; lamp cores must not wash out facade contrast.
lighting.reflections: Raster SSR plus captures or authored broad road reflections; label approximations. No Lumen requirement.
lighting.fog: Height/depth haze with distant light field still visible; do not black-out everything beyond340m.

beats.label: Ridge overlook
beats.intent: City already occupies broad horizon. Near palms bracket central downhill road.

beats.label: Descending boulevard
beats.intent: Road lights and cross streets reveal multiple depth planes; isolated taller buildings sit back.

beats.label: Bay opening
beats.intent: Right frontage opens to water; distant opposite shore remains lit; same coherent skyline.

beats.label: Next neighborhood approach
beats.intent: Brief speed ease, landmark moves plausibly; street continues beyond cut.

continuity.nextSegment: Must begin at endState, retain district/landmark coordinates, exposure, light and traffic phases. Flatten grade smoothly over next120m (ending elevation0.6m) before coastal plateau; keep sea at-3m.
continuity.gradeTransitionFormula: For successor0<=q<=120: grade(q)=-0.03*(1-3*(q/120)^2+2*(q/120)^3); integrate from y=2.4. Grade derivative zero at both ends.
continuity.traffic: Persistent object IDs and global-timeline paths; export positions/headings/visibility. No hidden spawn at clip boundary.
continuity.texturePhase: World/station-derived UVs and emissive seeds remain stable across split.
continuity.decoderRule: Two-slot warmed playback with shared clock. Measure actual presentation gap; do not call crossfade a continuous route.

budgets.qualityGate: Four native world-only frames, then2s motion, then60s sequence. Reject box-wall skyline or missing depth before long render.
